{{Top|leg}}
'''Situational Enforcements Officers''' served the [[Situational Enforcement/Legends|Situational Enforcement]] branch of the [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority's]] [[Security Division]]. Instead of performing investigations in a specific territory, SEOs analyzed criminal patterns from across the [[Corporate Sector/Legends|Corporate Sector]].
